tasks.title: Setup React Router and Core Page Architecture
tasks.description: Implement React Router v7 with file-based routing and create the foundational page components for the Chronos Editor application shell
tasks.details: Install react-router@^7.9.4 and configure browser history SPA routing. Create routes configuration in src/routes/AppRoutes.tsx with paths for /, /projects, /projects/:projectId/editor, /media, /settings. Implement RootLayout.tsx with global shell structure including sidebar and topbar navigation. Create basic page components: LandingPage.tsx, ProjectsPage.tsx, ProjectEditorPage.tsx, MediaLibraryPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx, NotFoundPage.tsx. Ensure React Router 7 data loading patterns with loaders and actions are set up for type-safe routing.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test route configuration, verify all routes render correctly, test navigation between pages, validate route parameters are passed correctly, test 404 fallback behavior

subtasks.title: Install and Configure React Router v7 with TypeScript
subtasks.description: Set up React Router v7.9.4 with TypeScript configuration, browser history, and SPA routing foundation
subtasks.details: Install react-router@^7.9.4 and react-router-dom dependencies. Configure TypeScript types for React Router v7. Set up browser history for SPA routing. Create initial router provider setup in main.tsx or App.tsx. Configure route type definitions and ensure proper TypeScript integration for type-safe routing throughout the application.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify package installation, test TypeScript compilation with route types, validate browser history initialization

subtasks.title: Create Type-Safe AppRoutes Configuration
subtasks.description: Build the centralized routes configuration with type-safe route definitions and parameters
subtasks.details: Create src/routes/AppRoutes.tsx with route definitions for all paths: /, /projects, /projects/:projectId/editor, /media, /settings. Define route types and interfaces for parameters. Implement type-safe route helper functions for navigation. Set up route constants to prevent hardcoded strings. Configure nested routing structure for project editor routes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test route configuration object, verify TypeScript types for route params, test route path generation helpers

subtasks.title: Build RootLayout Component with Navigation Shell
subtasks.description: Implement the main layout component with sidebar navigation and topbar structure
subtasks.details: Create RootLayout.tsx as the application shell wrapper. Build sidebar navigation component with links to all main routes using NavLink components. Implement topbar with branding and user controls. Set up Outlet for nested route rendering. Apply responsive layout styles and ensure proper navigation highlighting for active routes. Integrate with shadcn/ui components for consistent styling.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test layout rendering, verify navigation link active states, test responsive behavior, validate Outlet rendering

subtasks.title: Create Core Page Components for Each Route
subtasks.description: Develop the main page components for landing, projects, editor, media library, and settings pages
subtasks.details: Create LandingPage.tsx with welcome content and getting started guide. Build ProjectsPage.tsx with project list placeholder. Implement ProjectEditorPage.tsx with basic editor shell and route param handling. Create MediaLibraryPage.tsx for asset management interface. Build SettingsPage.tsx with configuration options. Ensure each component properly integrates with the layout and handles route-specific data.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each page component renders correctly, verify route parameter extraction in editor page, test component mounting/unmounting

subtasks.title: Implement Error Handling and NotFound Page
subtasks.description: Set up comprehensive error handling with error boundaries and 404 fallback page
subtasks.details: Create NotFoundPage.tsx with user-friendly 404 message and navigation back to home. Implement ErrorBoundary component for route-level error catching. Set up error recovery mechanisms and logging. Configure catch-all route for 404 handling. Add error boundaries at strategic component levels. Implement user-friendly error messages and recovery actions for common routing errors.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test 404 page rendering for invalid routes, verify error boundary catches component errors, test error recovery flows

subtasks.title: Wire Up Navigation and Verify Complete Routing System
subtasks.description: Connect all navigation elements and perform comprehensive routing system verification
subtasks.details: Wire up all navigation links in sidebar and other UI elements. Implement programmatic navigation helpers using useNavigate hook. Set up route guards if needed for protected routes. Verify deep linking works correctly. Test browser back/forward button functionality. Ensure route transitions are smooth. Add loading states for lazy-loaded routes if applicable. Perform end-to-end navigation testing across all routes.
subtasks.testStrategy: End-to-end navigation testing, verify browser history manipulation, test deep linking, validate route parameter passing

tasks.title: Implement Dark Mode UI Theme System
tasks.description: Configure TailwindCSS with dark-mode-first design system and integrate Shadcn UI component library for consistent theming
tasks.details: Configure Tailwind 4.x with dark mode as default, implementing the zinc color palette (zinc-950 background, zinc-900 surfaces, zinc-800 elements, zinc-700 borders). Install and configure Shadcn UI components via CLI (shadcn@^3.5.0). Set up design tokens in tailwind.config.ts for consistent theming. Create ThemeProvider component for managing theme state. Implement CSS variables for dynamic theming support. Ensure all components follow the dark-mode-first aesthetic with blue-500 accent colors for interactive elements.
tasks.testStrategy: Visual regression testing for theme consistency, test theme provider context, verify Shadcn components render with correct dark theme styles, validate CSS variables are applied correctly

subtasks.title: Configure Tailwind 4.x with zinc color palette and dark mode defaults
subtasks.description: Set up Tailwind CSS 4.x configuration with dark mode as the default theme, implementing the zinc color palette for backgrounds, surfaces, elements, and borders
subtasks.details: Install Tailwind CSS 4.x dependencies. Configure tailwind.config.ts to use dark mode as default with class-based switching. Define the zinc color palette: zinc-950 for backgrounds, zinc-900 for surfaces, zinc-800 for UI elements, zinc-700 for borders. Set blue-500 as the primary accent color for interactive elements. Configure CSS variables for dynamic color theming. Ensure proper color contrast ratios for accessibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify Tailwind configuration loads correctly, test color palette values are applied, validate CSS variable generation, check dark mode class switching functionality

subtasks.title: Install and configure Shadcn UI component library via CLI
subtasks.description: Install Shadcn UI components using the CLI tool and configure them to work with the dark-mode-first theme system
subtasks.details: Run npx shadcn@latest init to initialize Shadcn UI with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS support. Configure components.json to use the zinc color scheme and dark theme as default. Install essential components like Button, Card, Dialog, Input, and Select using the CLI. Verify all components inherit the dark theme styles correctly. Update component CSS variables to match the zinc palette. Ensure component styles integrate seamlessly with Tailwind configuration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test component installation process, verify component rendering with dark theme, validate CSS variable inheritance, check component styling consistency

subtasks.title: Create ThemeProvider component for managing theme state
subtasks.description: Build a React context-based ThemeProvider component that manages theme state, handles theme switching, and persists user preferences
subtasks.details: Create ThemeContext using React.createContext with theme state and toggle function. Implement ThemeProvider component that wraps the application and manages theme state. Add localStorage persistence for user theme preference. Implement system preference detection using window.matchMedia for prefers-color-scheme. Create useTheme custom hook for consuming theme context in components. Add theme switching logic that updates document root class for Tailwind. Prevent flash of unstyled content on initial load.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test context provider functionality, verify localStorage persistence, test system preference detection, validate theme switching without FOUC, test useTheme hook behavior

subtasks.title: Set up design tokens in tailwind configuration for consistent theming
subtasks.description: Define and configure design tokens in Tailwind configuration for spacing, typography, shadows, and other design system properties
subtasks.details: Create design token structure in tailwind.config.ts for consistent spacing scale, typography settings, and shadow values. Define semantic color tokens for primary, secondary, success, warning, and error states using CSS variables. Configure border radius tokens for consistent component styling. Set up animation tokens for transitions and interactions. Create utility classes for common patterns like glass morphism effects and gradient backgrounds. Document token usage patterns for developer reference.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate design token application across components, test CSS variable fallbacks, verify token consistency in generated CSS, test responsive token values

subtasks.title: Integrate ThemeProvider and verify dark-mode-first implementation
subtasks.description: Integrate the ThemeProvider into the application root and verify that all components and pages follow the dark-mode-first design system
subtasks.details: Wrap the application root with ThemeProvider component in main.tsx or App.tsx. Apply dark theme classes to all existing components and pages. Verify Shadcn UI components respond correctly to theme changes. Test theme persistence across page refreshes and navigation. Validate color contrast ratios meet WCAG accessibility standards. Create a theme toggle component for user control. Ensure all interactive elements use the blue-500 accent color consistently. Document theme usage guidelines for future development.
subtasks.testStrategy: End-to-end testing of theme switching, visual regression testing for theme consistency, accessibility testing for color contrast, performance testing for theme switching speed

tasks.title: Build Core Zustand State Management Architecture
tasks.description: Set up Zustand 5.x stores for managing editor state, timeline state, media library, and project data with proper TypeScript typing
tasks.details: Install zustand@^5.0.0 with middleware (persist, devtools, immer). Create vanilla stores with React Context pattern: TimelineStore (clips, tracks, playhead, zoom), MediaStore (assets, folders, upload queue), ProjectStore (project metadata, dirty state, autosave), EditorStore (preview settings, tool selection). Implement proper TypeScript interfaces for all store states. Set up store providers and custom hooks (useTimelineStore, useMediaStore, etc). Configure IndexedDB persistence for thumbnails and local caching strategies.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test all store actions and selectors, test middleware functionality (persistence, devtools), verify store updates trigger proper React re-renders, test store reset and initialization

subtasks.title: Install Zustand 5.x with Required Middleware Packages
subtasks.description: Install zustand@^5.0.0 along with immer, persist, and devtools middleware packages, and set up the initial project structure for state management
subtasks.details: Run npm install zustand@^5.0.0 immer zustand/middleware. Create src/stores directory structure with subdirectories for each store type. Set up initial TypeScript configuration for Zustand with strict typing. Install @types/node for IndexedDB types if needed. Create a stores/index.ts barrel export file for centralized store access.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify package installation and imports work correctly, test that middleware can be imported without errors

subtasks.title: Design and Implement TypeScript Interfaces for All Store States
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive TypeScript type definitions and interfaces for Timeline, Media, Project, and Editor store states with proper typing for all properties
subtasks.details: Create types/stores.ts with interfaces: ITimelineState (clips array, tracks array, playhead number, zoom level), IMediaState (assets map, folders array, uploadQueue array), IProjectState (metadata object, isDirty boolean, lastSaved timestamp), IEditorState (previewSettings object, selectedTool enum). Define action types for each store. Create utility types for common patterns like clips, tracks, and assets. Ensure all types are exported for use across stores.
subtasks.testStrategy: Type-check all interfaces with TypeScript compiler, ensure no any types are used, validate type inference works correctly

subtasks.title: Implement TimelineStore with Clips, Tracks, and Playhead Management
subtasks.description: Build the TimelineStore using vanilla Zustand pattern with actions for managing clips, tracks, playhead position, and zoom level with proper reactivity
subtasks.details: Create stores/timelineStore.ts with createStore pattern. Implement state: clips (Map<string, Clip>), tracks (array with video/audio/text types), playhead (frame number), zoom (0.25-8x range). Add actions: addClip, removeClip, updateClip, moveClip, addTrack, removeTrack, setPlayhead, setZoom. Use immer for immutable updates. Implement computed values for visible clips based on viewport. Add selection state management for multi-clip operations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test all timeline actions, verify state updates trigger re-renders, test clip visibility calculations, validate zoom constraints

subtasks.title: Create MediaStore for Assets and Upload Queue Management
subtasks.description: Develop the MediaStore to handle media assets, folder organization, upload queue, and thumbnail caching with efficient data structures
subtasks.details: Create stores/mediaStore.ts with asset management structure. Implement state: assets (Map<string, MediaAsset>), folders (hierarchical structure), uploadQueue (array with progress tracking), thumbnailCache (Map). Add actions: addAsset, removeAsset, moveAsset, createFolder, queueUpload, updateUploadProgress, cacheThumbnail. Include file type validation and size limits. Implement search/filter functionality for assets. Add batch operations support for multiple file handling.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test asset CRUD operations, verify upload queue processing, test folder hierarchy operations, validate thumbnail caching

subtasks.title: Build ProjectStore for Metadata and Autosave Functionality
subtasks.description: Implement ProjectStore to manage project metadata, dirty state tracking, and autosave functionality with proper persistence handling
subtasks.details: Create stores/projectStore.ts with project lifecycle management. Implement state: metadata (name, description, createdAt, updatedAt), settings (fps, resolution, duration), isDirty (boolean), lastSaved (timestamp), autosaveInterval (number). Add actions: updateMetadata, setDirty, saveProject, loadProject, exportProject. Implement autosave timer logic with configurable intervals. Add version tracking for project format migrations. Include project validation before save operations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test metadata updates, verify dirty state tracking, test autosave timer functionality, validate save/load operations

subtasks.title: Implement EditorStore for Preview and Tool Selection State
subtasks.description: Create EditorStore to manage editor UI state including preview settings, selected tools, and workspace configuration
subtasks.details: Create stores/editorStore.ts for editor UI state. Implement state: previewSettings (quality, resolution, fullscreen), selectedTool (enum: select, trim, split, text), workspace (panel visibility, layout), shortcuts (customizable keybindings). Add actions: setPreviewQuality, selectTool, togglePanel, updateLayout, registerShortcut. Include tool-specific state (brush size for text, selection mode). Implement workspace preset management for different editing workflows.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test tool selection changes, verify preview settings updates, test workspace layout persistence, validate shortcut registration

subtasks.title: Set Up Store Providers with React Context Pattern
subtasks.description: Create React Context providers and custom hooks for all stores following Zustand 5.x vanilla store pattern with proper TypeScript typing
subtasks.details: Create contexts/StoreContext.tsx with createContext for each store. Implement StoreProvider component that initializes all stores and provides them via context. Create custom hooks: useTimelineStore, useMediaStore, useProjectStore, useEditorStore with useContext and useSyncExternalStore. Add selector support for performance optimization (useTimelineStore(state => state.playhead)). Implement store reset functionality for testing. Ensure proper TypeScript inference for all hooks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test context providers render correctly, verify hooks return correct store instances, test selector performance, validate TypeScript types

subtasks.title: Configure IndexedDB Persistence and DevTools Integration
subtasks.description: Set up IndexedDB persistence for stores, configure Redux DevTools integration, and implement local caching strategies for thumbnails and project data
subtasks.details: Configure zustand/middleware persist with IndexedDB adapter for ProjectStore and MediaStore. Implement custom storage engine for thumbnail blob caching in IndexedDB. Set up Redux DevTools integration with proper action names and state snapshots. Create migration strategies for store schema changes. Implement cache invalidation logic for stale data. Add storage quota management and cleanup routines. Configure different persistence strategies per store (memory-only for EditorStore, persist for ProjectStore).
subtasks.testStrategy: Test persistence across page reloads, verify IndexedDB storage limits, test DevTools time-travel debugging, validate migration logic

tasks.title: Create Timeline Component with Virtualization
tasks.description: Build the core timeline component with track management, clip rendering, and efficient virtualization for performance
tasks.details: Install react-virtuoso@^4.6.2 for virtualization. Create Timeline component structure: TimelineRuler (time markers, zoom controls), TrackList (virtualized track rendering), ClipRenderer (optimized clip display). Implement frame-based timebase calculations (30fps default). Add zoom controls (0.25x-8x range) with keyboard shortcuts. Create track types (video, audio, text) with controls (lock, mute, labels). Implement horizontal scroll synchronization between ruler and tracks. Add clip selection, snapping logic, and basic drag-and-drop support. Optimize rendering to only show visible clips based on scroll position.
tasks.testStrategy: Performance test with 100+ clips, test virtualization scroll behavior, verify zoom calculations, test clip visibility calculations, validate track synchronization, test memory usage with large timelines

subtasks.title: Install and Configure React Virtuoso Library
subtasks.description: Set up react-virtuoso@^4.6.2 for efficient virtualization of timeline tracks and clips, configure basic list virtualization settings
subtasks.details: Install react-virtuoso@^4.6.2 via npm. Create a basic virtualization configuration file with default settings for row height estimation, overscan, and scroll behavior. Set up TypeScript types for virtuoso components. Configure virtuoso to work with horizontal scrolling for timeline implementation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test virtuoso installation and basic rendering, verify TypeScript types compile correctly, test basic list virtualization with mock data

subtasks.title: Build TimelineRuler Component with Time Markers
subtasks.description: Create the timeline ruler component that displays time markers, frame numbers, and provides visual time reference for the timeline
subtasks.details: Create TimelineRuler component with dynamic time marker generation based on zoom level. Implement time formatting (00:00:00:00 for hours:minutes:seconds:frames). Calculate marker intervals dynamically (every second, 5 seconds, 30 seconds based on zoom). Style ruler with zinc-800 background following dark theme. Add major and minor tick marks for visual hierarchy.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test time marker calculations at different zoom levels, verify correct time formatting, test ruler responsiveness to window resizing

subtasks.title: Implement TrackList with Virtualized Rendering
subtasks.description: Build the main track list container using react-virtuoso for efficient rendering of potentially hundreds of tracks
subtasks.details: Create TrackList component using Virtuoso's List component. Implement variable height tracks support for different track types. Set up track data structure with id, type, height, and clips array. Configure virtuoso scrolling behavior for smooth performance. Implement track header rendering with controls. Set up proper item rendering with React.memo for optimization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test rendering performance with 100+ tracks, verify virtualization only renders visible tracks, test scroll performance metrics

subtasks.title: Create ClipRenderer with Optimized Display Logic
subtasks.description: Build the clip rendering component with visibility culling and optimized rendering based on viewport
subtasks.details: Create ClipRenderer component that only renders clips within viewport. Implement clip visibility calculation based on timeline scroll position and zoom level. Add clip thumbnail rendering with lazy loading. Create clip selection visual feedback with border highlighting. Optimize with React.memo and useMemo for expensive calculations. Add clip duration display and resize handles.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test clip visibility calculations, verify only visible clips render, test memory usage with large number of clips, validate selection state updates

subtasks.title: Implement Frame-Based Timebase Calculations System
subtasks.description: Create the core timebase calculation system for converting between frames, seconds, and timeline pixels at 30fps default
subtasks.details: Create TimebaseCalculator utility class with methods for frame-to-time, time-to-frame, and pixel-to-frame conversions. Implement support for different framerates (24, 25, 30, 60 fps). Create hooks for accessing timebase calculations in components. Add SMPTE timecode formatting support. Implement frame snapping logic for precise editing. Cache calculations for performance optimization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test all conversion functions with edge cases, verify frame accuracy at different framerates, test pixel-to-frame calculations at various zoom levels

subtasks.title: Add Zoom Controls with Keyboard Shortcuts
subtasks.description: Implement zoom functionality with range 0.25x-8x, smooth zooming animations, and keyboard shortcut support
subtasks.details: Create ZoomControls component with slider and preset buttons (fit to window, 1:1, zoom in/out). Implement keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd + Plus/Minus for zoom, Ctrl/Cmd + 0 for fit). Add smooth zoom transitions with requestAnimationFrame. Update timeline pixel calculations on zoom changes. Maintain playhead position during zoom. Store zoom level in Zustand TimelineStore.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test zoom range limits, verify keyboard shortcuts work correctly, test zoom performance with complex timelines, validate playhead position preservation

subtasks.title: Build Track Type System for Video, Audio, and Text
subtasks.description: Create specialized track components for different media types with appropriate controls and visual representations
subtasks.details: Create VideoTrack component with thumbnail previews and opacity controls. Build AudioTrack with waveform visualization placeholder and volume controls. Implement TextTrack for titles/captions with text preview. Add track controls: lock/unlock, show/hide, mute (for audio), solo, track color coding. Create track height adjustment functionality. Implement track reordering with drag handles.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each track type renders correctly, verify track controls update state properly, test track type switching, validate track reordering logic

subtasks.title: Implement Horizontal Scroll Synchronization
subtasks.description: Create synchronized horizontal scrolling between timeline ruler, tracks, and any other timeline components
subtasks.details: Create TimelineScrollContext for managing shared scroll state. Implement scroll event handlers that update all timeline components simultaneously. Add smooth scroll behavior with debouncing for performance. Ensure ruler and tracks stay perfectly aligned during scrolling. Handle scroll position persistence in TimelineStore. Add programmatic scrolling for playhead following.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test scroll synchronization accuracy, verify no visual lag between components, test scroll performance with heavy content, validate scroll position persistence

subtasks.title: Add Clip Selection, Snapping, and Drag-and-Drop
subtasks.description: Implement interactive clip manipulation features including selection, magnetic snapping, and drag-and-drop repositioning
subtasks.details: Implement clip selection with click, shift-click for multiple selection, and marquee selection. Add magnetic snapping to other clips, markers, and playhead with configurable snap threshold. Create drag-and-drop system using HTML5 drag API or custom mouse events. Implement clip movement constraints within track bounds. Add visual feedback during dragging with ghost preview. Store selection state in TimelineStore.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test selection logic with various interaction patterns, verify snapping accuracy at different zoom levels, test drag-and-drop across tracks, validate undo/redo for clip movements

tasks.title: Implement Media Upload System with S3 Integration
tasks.description: Create direct-to-S3 upload system with presigned URLs, progress tracking, and media asset management
tasks.details: Create MediaUpload component with drag-and-drop support and file picker. Implement upload flow: request presigned URL from backend POST /api/v1/media/upload, validate file size/type against environment limits (100MB images, 1GB videos, 500MB audio), upload directly to S3 with XMLHttpRequest for progress tracking, confirm upload completion with backend. Create upload queue management in MediaStore. Implement thumbnail generation requests post-upload. Add upload progress UI with cancel capability. Handle multiple concurrent uploads with proper error recovery.
tasks.testStrategy: Test file validation logic, mock S3 uploads for unit tests, test progress tracking accuracy, verify error handling for failed uploads, test concurrent upload limits, validate presigned URL handling

subtasks.title: Create MediaUpload Component with Drag-and-Drop Interface
subtasks.description: Build the main MediaUpload React component with drag-and-drop functionality, file picker, and visual feedback for drag states
subtasks.details: Create MediaUpload.tsx component using React hooks. Implement drag-and-drop zone with onDragEnter, onDragLeave, onDragOver, and onDrop handlers. Add file input element with multiple file selection support. Create visual feedback states (idle, drag-over, uploading) using Tailwind classes. Include drop zone UI with upload icon and instructional text. Integrate with Shadcn UI components for consistent styling. Handle both drag-and-drop and click-to-browse file selection methods.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test drag event handlers with mock files, verify file input works for multiple selections, test visual state transitions, validate component renders correctly with dark theme

subtasks.title: Implement File Validation Against Size and Type Limits
subtasks.description: Create validation logic to check uploaded files against configured limits for file size and supported media types
subtasks.details: Build validateFile function that checks against environment-configured limits: 100MB for images (jpg, png, webp, gif), 1GB for videos (mp4, webm, mov, avi), 500MB for audio (mp3, wav, ogg, m4a). Create FileValidationError class with specific error types (INVALID_TYPE, FILE_TOO_LARGE). Implement batch validation for multiple files. Add user-friendly error messages for each validation failure. Store validation rules in a configuration object for easy maintenance. Return detailed validation results including which files passed/failed and why.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test validation logic with various file sizes and types, test edge cases at size boundaries, verify error messages are descriptive, test batch validation with mixed valid/invalid files

subtasks.title: Request Presigned URLs from Backend API
subtasks.description: Implement API integration to request presigned URLs from the backend for direct S3 uploads
subtasks.details: Create uploadService.ts with requestPresignedUrl function. Make POST request to /api/v1/media/upload with file metadata (name, size, type, checksum). Handle authentication headers if required. Parse response containing presigned URL, S3 key, and upload parameters. Implement retry logic with exponential backoff for failed requests. Add request timeout handling (30 seconds). Cache presigned URLs temporarily with expiration tracking. Handle various error responses (401, 403, 413, 429, 500) with appropriate user messaging.
subtasks.testStrategy: Mock API responses for success and error cases, test retry logic with network failures, verify request payload structure, test timeout handling, validate error response parsing

subtasks.title: Implement Direct-to-S3 Upload with XMLHttpRequest
subtasks.description: Build the core S3 upload functionality using XMLHttpRequest for progress tracking capabilities
subtasks.details: Create S3Uploader class using XMLHttpRequest for direct browser-to-S3 uploads. Implement upload method that takes presigned URL and file. Set up progress event listeners to track upload percentage in real-time. Configure proper CORS headers for S3 requests. Handle upload.onload for success confirmation and upload.onerror for failures. Implement chunk-based uploading for large files if needed. Add abort functionality to cancel in-progress uploads. Parse S3 response headers for ETag verification. Send completion confirmation to backend with S3 key and ETag.
subtasks.testStrategy: Mock XMLHttpRequest for unit tests, test progress event calculations, verify abort functionality works correctly, test error handling for network failures, validate S3 response parsing

subtasks.title: Build Upload Progress Tracking System
subtasks.description: Create a comprehensive progress tracking system with UI components showing upload status, speed, and time remaining
subtasks.details: Create UploadProgress component with progress bar, percentage display, upload speed (MB/s), and estimated time remaining. Implement progress calculation logic using XMLHttpRequest progress events. Add circular progress indicator for individual files and linear progress for overall batch. Calculate and display transfer rate using moving average algorithm. Show file name, size, and status (queued, uploading, completed, failed). Add pause/resume and cancel buttons for each upload. Create toast notifications for upload completion and failures. Implement smooth progress animations using CSS transitions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test progress calculations with various file sizes, verify time remaining estimates, test UI updates with mock progress events, validate cancel/pause functionality, test animation performance

subtasks.title: Create Upload Queue Management in MediaStore
subtasks.description: Implement upload queue state management using Zustand store with queue operations and persistence
subtasks.details: Extend MediaStore with upload queue functionality: addToQueue, removeFromQueue, updateProgress, setStatus methods. Create UploadItem interface with id, file, progress, status, error, retryCount properties. Implement queue ordering with priority support. Add concurrent upload limit control (default 3 simultaneous uploads). Create queue persistence to localStorage for recovery after page refresh. Implement automatic queue processing when uploads complete. Add batch operations for queue management (clear completed, retry all failed). Track overall queue progress statistics. Integrate with React components using useMediaStore hook.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test queue operations (add, remove, reorder), verify concurrent upload limits, test persistence and recovery, validate state updates trigger re-renders, test batch operations

subtasks.title: Handle Concurrent Uploads with Error Recovery and Retry Logic
subtasks.description: Implement robust error handling, automatic retry mechanism, and management of multiple concurrent uploads
subtasks.details: Create UploadManager class to coordinate multiple concurrent uploads with configurable limit (max 3). Implement exponential backoff retry strategy (3 attempts, 2-4-8 second delays). Handle various error types: network failures, S3 errors, timeout errors, validation errors. Add automatic retry for transient errors (network, 503, 429). Implement manual retry option for permanent failures. Create error recovery mechanism to resume interrupted uploads. Add upload health monitoring to detect stuck uploads. Implement graceful degradation when S3 is unavailable. Log detailed error information for debugging. Provide clear user feedback for each error type with actionable messages.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test retry logic with simulated failures, verify concurrent upload limiting, test error recovery scenarios, validate exponential backoff timing, test stuck upload detection

tasks.title: Build Playback Engine with DOM-based Preview
tasks.description: Implement hybrid DOM and canvas-based preview engine for real-time playback of timeline compositions
tasks.details: Create PlaybackEngine class managing playback state (play, pause, seek). Implement frame ticker using requestAnimationFrame for smooth playback. Build preview renderer: compute active clips at current frame, render video tracks using single video element with source switching, overlay images/text as positioned DOM layers, apply CSS transforms for opacity/scale/position. Add playback controls component with play/pause, frame stepping, speed control. Implement audio synchronization with Web Audio API. Handle preview quality settings and performance optimization. Ensure sub-100ms response for timeline interactions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test playback accuracy at different speeds, verify frame calculations, test clip transition timing, validate audio sync, performance test with complex compositions, test memory management during playback

subtasks.title: Create PlaybackEngine class with state management
subtasks.description: Build the core PlaybackEngine class with methods for play, pause, seek, and state management including current time, duration, and playback rate
subtasks.details: Create PlaybackEngine.ts class with TypeScript interfaces for PlaybackState (playing, paused, stopped), currentTime, duration, playbackRate. Implement methods: play(), pause(), stop(), seek(time), setPlaybackRate(rate). Use MobX or Zustand for reactive state management. Initialize with timeline reference and emit state change events.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test state transitions, verify event emissions, test edge cases for seek boundaries

subtasks.title: Implement requestAnimationFrame ticker system
subtasks.description: Build frame ticker using requestAnimationFrame for smooth 30/60fps playback with precise timing calculations
subtasks.details: Create FrameTicker class managing requestAnimationFrame loop. Calculate delta time between frames for accurate playback timing. Implement start/stop controls tied to PlaybackEngine state. Handle tab visibility changes to pause/resume ticker. Maintain target FPS (30/60) with frame dropping for performance. Calculate current playback position based on elapsed time and playback rate.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test frame rate consistency, verify delta time calculations, test pause/resume on visibility change

subtasks.title: Build frame-to-clip resolver for timeline queries
subtasks.description: Implement efficient algorithm to determine which clips are active at any given frame/timestamp on the timeline
subtasks.details: Create ClipResolver class with getActiveClips(timestamp) method. Build indexed data structure for O(log n) clip lookups. Handle overlapping clips across multiple tracks. Calculate clip local time based on in/out points. Support clip trimming offsets. Cache active clip sets for performance. Update resolver when timeline changes. Return sorted array by track z-index.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test clip resolution accuracy, benchmark performance with 100+ clips, verify cache invalidation

subtasks.title: Implement video element pool with source switching
subtasks.description: Create video element management system for efficient source switching between video clips during playback
subtasks.details: Build VideoElementPool managing reusable video elements. Implement preloading strategy for upcoming clips. Handle seamless source switching without visual glitches. tasks.title: Create WebSocket Real-time Updates System
tasks.description: Implement WebSocket connection management for receiving job updates, export progress, and AI generation status

Set up Redux/Zustand integration for state updates from WebSocket messages. Create connection status indicator UI. Handle authentication/session management for WebSocket connections. Implement exponential backoff for reconnection attempts. Add message queuing for offline scenarios. Create typed message interfaces matching backend JobUpdateMessage schema.

subtasks.title: Create WebSocketService class with connection management

subtasks.details: Create src/services/WebSocketService.ts with singleton pattern. Implement connect() method that establishes WebSocket connection to backend URL from environment config. Add disconnect() method for clean shutdown. Create message send queue and event emitter for incoming messages. Handle WebSocket readyState transitions. Store connection instance and provide getters for connection status.

subtasks.title: Implement reconnection logic with exponential backoff
subtasks.description: Add automatic reconnection capability with exponential backoff strategy to handle network interruptions and server restarts gracefully
subtasks.details: Implement reconnection strategy with initial delay of 1 second, max delay of 30 seconds, and backoff multiplier of 1.5. Add reconnectAttempts counter and maxReconnectAttempts limit (default 10). Create handleConnectionLost() method that triggers backoff timer. Implement resetBackoff() on successful connection. Add reconnection events for UI updates. Handle permanent failure scenarios with error callbacks.

subtasks.title: Build heartbeat/ping-pong mechanism

Add heartbeatInterval and pongTimeout configuration options. Create startHeartbeat() and stopHeartbeat() methods. Handle missing pong responses by triggering reconnection. Ensure heartbeat stops during disconnection and resumes after reconnection. Add heartbeat status to connection health metrics.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test ping message sending, simulate pong timeouts, verify reconnection trigger on heartbeat failure

subtasks.title: Create message handlers for job.update events

Implement message validation and error handling for malformed messages. Create type guards for message type checking.

subtasks.title: Integrate with Zustand stores for state updates

subtasks.details: Create useWebSocketStore for connection status management. Integrate job update messages with existing job/export stores. Implement store update methods for each job event type. Add optimistic updates with rollback capability. Create subscription mechanism for components to listen to specific event types. Ensure store updates are batched for performance. Handle race conditions between REST API and WebSocket updates.

subtasks.title: Implement connection status indicator UI

subtasks.title: Handle authentication and session management

subtasks.title: Add message queuing for offline scenarios

Add queue status metrics for monitoring. Handle queue overflow scenarios with user notification. Ensure idempotent message handling on backend.

subtasks.title: Implement project selection navigation and delete confirmation
subtasks.description: Add click handlers for opening projects in editor and deleting projects with confirmation dialog
subtasks.details: Create handleOpenProject function using useCallback that takes projectId and calls navigate(`/projects/${projectId}/editor`) using useNavigate hook. Wire this to ProjectCard click and open button. Create DeleteConfirmDialog component using Shadcn AlertDialog for destructive confirmation. Implement handleDeleteProject using useCallback that shows confirmation dialog, and on confirm calls ProjectStore.removeProject(projectId) and shows success toast. Handle errors with error toast. Add optimistic updates - immediately update UI then rollback on error using useOptimistic pattern from React 19. Prevent deletion of currently open project with validation check.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test project selection navigates to correct route, verify delete confirmation dialog shows, test delete removes project from store and UI, validate optimistic updates work correctly, test error handling rolls back optimistic update, verify cannot delete open project

tasks.title: Implement Media Library UI Integration
tasks.description: Integrate MediaUpload component into MediaLibraryPage and connect upload workflow with MediaStore
tasks.details: Wire up MediaLibraryPage with MediaUpload component and MediaStore for complete media asset management. Import and render MediaUpload component in MediaLibraryPage, passing onFilesSelected callback that queues files in MediaStore. Implement media grid display showing asset thumbnails from MediaStore with metadata (name, type, size, upload date). Create upload progress indicator UI showing active uploads from MediaStore.uploadQueue with progress bars, file names, and cancel buttons. Add asset selection functionality with click/shift-click for multi-select, storing selected IDs in MediaStore. Implement delete assets functionality with confirmation dialog calling MediaStore.removeAsset. Create folder management UI with create/navigate/delete folder operations. Add search/filter bar using MediaStore.searchAssets. Display empty state when no media exists with upload CTA. Connect Upload Media buttons (header and empty state) to trigger MediaUpload file picker programmatically. Follow React best practices: functional components with hooks, immutable state updates, useCallback for event handlers. Use Zustand selectors for optimal performance. Implement loading states and error handling with toast notifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Test MediaUpload component renders and file selection works, verify upload queue displays with progress tracking, test asset grid renders from MediaStore, validate asset selection and multi-select, test delete confirmation and state updates, verify search/filter functionality, test folder operations, validate empty state and upload button integration

subtasks.title: Integrate MediaUpload component into MediaLibraryPage
subtasks.description: Import and render MediaUpload component with file selection callback that queues uploads in MediaStore
subtasks.details: In MediaLibraryPage.tsx, import MediaUpload component. Create handleFilesSelected callback using useCallback that takes File[] array. Call MediaStore.queueUpload for each file using useMediaStore selector to access queueUpload action. Add MediaUpload component to page layout (conditionally show when no uploads active, or always show in dedicated area). Pass onFilesSelected={handleFilesSelected} prop to MediaUpload. Wire up header Upload Media button using useRef to store MediaUpload ref and trigger file picker programmatically. Also wire empty state Upload button to same trigger. Handle file validation errors with toast notifications. Follow immutable state updates in MediaStore queue.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test MediaUpload renders in page, verify file selection callback queues in MediaStore, test Upload buttons trigger file picker, validate error toasts show for invalid files

subtasks.title: Build upload progress indicator UI component
subtasks.description: Create component showing active uploads from MediaStore.uploadQueue with progress bars and cancel functionality
subtasks.details: Create UploadProgressList.tsx component. Use useMediaStore selector to read uploadQueue array (use shallow from zustand/shallow). Map over uploadQueue and render UploadProgressItem for each upload. Create UploadProgressItem showing file name, size, progress bar (use Shadcn Progress component), upload speed (MB/s), estimated time remaining, status (queued/uploading/completed/failed), and cancel button. Calculate progress percentage from uploadItem.progress (0-100). Implement handleCancelUpload callback that calls MediaStore.cancelUpload(uploadId). Show success/error toast on upload complete/failed. Use React.memo on UploadProgressItem to prevent unnecessary re-renders. Display list as floating panel or in sidebar.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test progress list renders active uploads, verify progress bars update correctly, test cancel button stops upload, validate success/error toasts appear, test memo prevents re-renders

subtasks.title: Create MediaAssetCard component for grid display
subtasks.description: Build reusable component showing media asset thumbnail, metadata, and selection state
subtasks.details: Create MediaAssetCard.tsx functional component accepting asset and isSelected props. Display thumbnail using asset.thumbnailUrl or MediaStore.thumbnailCache for images/videos, or file type icon for audio. Show asset name, type badge (image/video/audio), file size formatted (e.g. 2.5 MB), upload date using Intl.DateTimeFormat. Add checkbox for selection (controlled by isSelected prop). Implement hover state with elevated card and overlay actions (delete, download). Use Shadcn Card component with zinc theme. Add click handler that toggles selection. Optimize with React.memo comparing asset.id and isSelected. Support keyboard navigation (Tab, Space to select).
subtasks.testStrategy: Test card renders with asset data, verify thumbnail displays correctly, test selection checkbox state, validate hover actions appear, test click toggles selection, verify memo optimization

subtasks.title: Implement media grid with MediaStore integration and selection
subtasks.description: Create grid layout that reads assets from MediaStore, handles selection state, and supports multi-select
subtasks.details: In MediaLibraryPage, use useMediaStore to read assets Map and selectedAssetIds array with shallow selector. Convert assets Map to array and filter by currentFolderId if set. Implement grid layout with Tailwind grid (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6). Map over assets and render MediaAssetCard with isSelected={selectedAssetIds.includes(asset.id)}. Create handleAssetClick callback using useCallback that calls MediaStore.selectAsset(assetId, event.shiftKey) for multi-select support. Implement shift-click range selection by tracking lastSelectedIndex. Add Ctrl/Cmd+A keyboard shortcut to select all visible assets. Show selected count in header toolbar. Display loading state while assets load from IndexedDB persistence.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test grid renders all assets from store, verify selection updates MediaStore state, test shift-click range selection, validate Ctrl+A selects all, test loading state displays, verify shallow selector prevents re-renders

subtasks.title: Add search/filter bar and asset deletion
subtasks.description: Implement search functionality using MediaStore.searchAssets and delete confirmation dialog
subtasks.details: Create search input in page header using Shadcn Input with search icon. Use useState for searchQuery state. Implement useEffect that calls MediaStore.searchAssets(searchQuery) and stores results. Display filtered results in grid instead of all assets. Add filter dropdown for asset type (all/images/videos/audio). Create DeleteConfirmDialog using Shadcn AlertDialog showing count of selected assets. Implement handleDeleteAssets using useCallback that shows confirmation, then calls MediaStore.removeAsset for each selectedAssetId on confirm. Clear selection after delete. Show success toast with count deleted. Handle errors with error toast. Use optimistic updates - remove from UI immediately then rollback on error.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test search filters assets correctly, verify type filter works, test delete confirmation shows correct count, validate delete removes assets from store, test optimistic updates rollback on error, verify selection clears after delete

subtasks.title: Implement folder management UI and navigation
subtasks.description: Create folder sidebar navigation with create/delete folder operations and folder-based filtering
subtasks.details: Create FolderSidebar component showing folder tree from MediaStore.folders array. Display folders in hierarchical structure with indentation for nested folders. Add Create Folder button that shows input for new folder name and calls MediaStore.createFolder. Implement handleFolderClick that calls MediaStore.setCurrentFolder(folderId) and filters assets in grid. Show active folder with highlight. Add delete folder button (icon) with confirmation dialog calling MediaStore.removeFolder. Display asset count for each folder. Use Shadcn Collapsible for nested folder expand/collapse. Handle drag-and-drop to move assets between folders using MediaStore.moveAsset. Show All Media option at top for unfiltered view.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test folder tree renders hierarchy correctly, verify create folder adds to store, test folder selection filters grid, validate delete removes folder and moves assets, test drag-and-drop moves assets, verify asset counts are accurate

tasks.title: Implement Timeline UI Integration into Project Editor Page
tasks.description: Wire up Timeline component into ProjectEditorPage to enable complete timeline editing functionality at route /projects/:projectId/editor
tasks.details: Integrate Timeline component into ProjectEditorPage with complete TimelineStore connection for interactive timeline editing. Import Timeline component and useTimelineStore hook from contexts. Replace placeholder timeline div (lines 68-75) with actual Timeline component rendering. Initialize default tracks (video, audio, text) on component mount using TimelineStore.addTrack if no tracks exist. Wire up all Timeline props to TimelineStore: tracks array, clips Map, selectedClipIds array, playhead position, zoom level, duration, and fps. Connect Timeline event handlers to store actions: onPlayheadChange calls TimelineStore.setPlayhead, onZoomChange calls setZoom, onClipSelect calls selectClip, onClipMove calls moveClip, onTrackUpdate calls updateTrack, onAddTrack calls addTrack. Ensure proper layout integration maintaining preview area above and properties panel on right side. Follow React best practices from DeepWiki research: use Zustand selectors with useShallow for optimal performance, prevent unnecessary re-renders by selecting only needed state slices, ensure immutable state updates in all store actions. Verify Timeline is fully interactive at route /projects/:projectId/editor with proper store synchronization.
tasks.testStrategy: Test Timeline component renders in ProjectEditorPage at route /projects/:projectId/editor, verify all timeline interactions (playhead drag, zoom, clip selection, track management) update TimelineStore correctly, validate store state changes trigger Timeline re-renders, test default tracks initialize on first mount, verify layout integration with preview and properties panels, test performance with useShallow selectors prevents unnecessary re-renders, validate immutable state updates throughout

subtasks.title: Initialize default tracks using TimelineStore on component mount

If no tracks exist, call timelineStore.addTrack three times to create default tracks: 1) Video track with type 'video', name 'Video 1', height 80, order 0, 2) Audio track with type 'audio', name 'Audio 1', height 60, order 1, 3) Text track with type 'text', name 'Text/Titles', height 60, order 2. Follow same pattern as TimelinePage.tsx for consistency. Set all tracks with locked: false, hidden: false, muted: false initially.

subtasks.title: Wire up Timeline props to TimelineStore state using selectors
subtasks.description: Connect all Timeline component props to TimelineStore state using optimized Zustand selectors with useShallow
subtasks.details: Import useShallow from 'zustand/react/shallow' for optimal selector performance. Use useTimelineStore with useShallow to select multiple state properties: const { tracks, clips, selectedClipIds, playhead, zoom, fps } = useTimelineStore(useShallow((state) => ({ tracks: state.tracks, clips: state.clips, selectedClipIds: state.selectedClipIds, playhead: state.playhead, zoom: state.zoom, fps: state.fps }))). Calculate duration: const duration = timelineStore.duration > 0 ? timelineStore.duration : timelineStore.fps * 300 (5 minutes default, matching TimelinePage pattern). Pass all props to Timeline component: tracks={tracks}, clips={clips}, selectedClipIds={selectedClipIds}, playhead={playhead}, zoom={zoom}, duration={duration}, fps={fps}. This ensures Timeline only re-renders when these specific state slices change, following DeepWiki best practices.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test Timeline receives correct state values from store, verify useShallow prevents unnecessary re-renders, validate duration calculation works correctly, test Timeline re-renders only when selected state changes

subtasks.title: Connect Timeline event handlers to TimelineStore actions
subtasks.description: Wire up all Timeline event handler props to corresponding TimelineStore actions using useCallback for performance
subtasks.details: Get store instance with const timelineStore = useTimelineStore(). Create event handler for adding tracks: const handleAddTrack = useCallback(() => { const trackNumber = timelineStore.tracks.length + 1; timelineStore.addTrack({ type: 'video', name: `Track ${trackNumber}`, height: 80, locked: false, hidden: false, muted: false, order: timelineStore.tracks.length }); }, [timelineStore]). Wire up Timeline event props: onPlayheadChange={timelineStore.setPlayhead}, onZoomChange={timelineStore.setZoom}, onClipSelect={timelineStore.selectClip}, onClipMove={timelineStore.moveClip}, onTrackUpdate={timelineStore.updateTrack}, onAddTrack={handleAddTrack}. Use useCallback only for complex handlers like handleAddTrack; simple store method references don't need wrapping per DeepWiki guidance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test playhead changes update store when dragging timeline, verify zoom controls modify store zoom level, validate clip selection updates selectedClipIds in store, test clip dragging calls moveClip with correct parameters, verify track updates persist to store, test add track button creates new track in store
